integrity: Analytical argument using explicit Beta matrix elements, Gamma scaling, nonstationary phase, and classical Toeplitz extension. A standalone numerical checker provides corroboration only; no independent audit or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed real Bergman weight alpha>-1, beta nonzero, gamma positive; continuous circle symbols only; Fredholm essential spectra, essential norms and indices, not full spectra or uniform parameter estimates. Historical priority is provisional pending broader literature review.
title: Log-Gamma spectral smoothing at the critical winding of weighted Bergman boundary spirals
